what: The frozen GBM signature matrix and cell-size factors, vendored into this repository so the pipeline can run without rebuilding a reference from a multi-gigabyte single-cell atlas.
derived_from: GBmap single-cell atlas, annotation_level_3, 100 donors, donor-balanced
known_limitations: No cross-donor variance (Sigma) is included. MuSiC's entire contribution is weighting genes by their cross-donor consistency, so with this reference MuSiC degenerates to residual-weighted NNLS. The pipeline detects this and records it rather than reporting a MuSiC result that is not one.
No donor-level profiles are included, so Bisque's assay transform falls back to the cell-type marginal, which is weaker than its no-overlap mode intends.
GFAP was down-weighted when this signature was built (see source_manifest.json correction_settings). That decision is inherited, not re-made here.
